reason: In the final section of this passage, Yahweh addresses Moses with the rhetorical question 'עַד־ אָנָה מֵֽאַנְתֶּם לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וְתוֹרֹתָֽי' ('How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?'). This follows the narrative of Yahweh testing the people with manna by providing it only on six days, with none on the Sabbath. When some of the people disobeyed and went out to gather on the seventh day, Yahweh's question expresses clear dissatisfaction with the people's refusal to obey His instructions. This constitutes a complaint or rebuke directed at the people for their disobedience.
